meta_data.base_class: Fetch comprehensive data on marine biodiversity for specified <ecosystems> - refers to natural systems formed by the interaction of biological communities and non-biological environments, such as oceans and deserts.

tool_template.name: <class>_biodiversity_data_fetch
tool_template.description: Fetch comprehensive data on biodiversity for specified <class> ecosystems.

zone_identifier.description: Identifier for the specific <class> ecosystem zone.

include_population_estimates.description: Whether to include population estimates for species in the <class> ecosystem.

data_format.description: Preferred format for the data output (e.g., JSON, XML).

time_period.description: The specific time period or range for which biodiversity data should be fetched for the <class> ecosystem (e.g., current, historical, projected).

data_source.description: The source or organization providing the biodiversity data for the <class> ecosystem (e.g., government, NGO, research institution).

include_climate_data.description: Whether to include climate data alongside biodiversity data for the <class> ecosystem.

species_focus.description: A list of specific species or groups of species for focused data retrieval within the <class> ecosystem.

threat_level.description: The level of threat to biodiversity in the <class> ecosystem as per recognized environmental standards (e.g., low, moderate, high).
